report.summary: Connected final audit of the frozen base f1e846d6→head 2b71e88c diff (116 files, ~17.1k additions) against the embedded governing requirements. The implementation matches the plan's technical and safety requirements in all materially checked areas: the A1 list-marker fix strips bullets only as layout while preserving qualifier/locator/injection checks; 60%+ guidance is modeled as an at_least lower bound with no invented ceiling; all five exact DOCN cash-bridge reconciliations appear as Decimal-exact test assertions with no residual plugging; YoY requires same-quarter-prior-year comparators. B's thesis module defines condition identity by normalized measurement contract excluding rationale (closing the live-05 duplicate-ID material finding, with alias coalescing and ambiguity-preserving warnings), computes met/breached/unknown via rounding intervals, and includes the required What-the-price-implies, funding-gap and net-obligations bridges with tamper recalculation. C's immutable publication store refuses same-run_id content revisions, never invents legacy timestamps, revalidates outcome return arithmetic from recorded prices, implements month-end-clamped calendar endpoints with first-completed-session exits, timezone-enforced publication cutoffs, coincident-window identity, and the corrected protocol labeling separating availability from prospective predeclaration (regression tests present). No credentials leak into the diff; attempt logs retain exception class only; no scheduler/broker/vendor/model-call additions; budget attestations (6/7 live attempts, $15.59 of $70; $30 audit allocation untouched) are within approved ceilings. Both previously open material findings are closed with red-to-green tests. Four low-severity findings; no critical/high/medium defects. Explicitly permitted pendings (prospective 3/6-month performance, typed consensus, live forward-funding scenario, browser screenshot, optional FRED) remain disclosed, not hidden.
limitations: Audit used only the frozen request.json (base/head SHAs, changed paths, requirements, diff); no repository checkout inspection, test execution, or network verification was performed.

Live-proof and full-suite claims (e.g., 2,207 passed; six paid CLI runs; artifact SHA-256 receipts) are attested in committed docs/reviews evidence JSONs whose referenced receipts live in untracked results/docn-abc/ paths outside the frozen diff; they are internally consistent across documents but not independently re-verifiable from the frozen manifest.

The diff is additions-dominated (~17,137 added lines); review was targeted at financial arithmetic, publication/settlement/thesis integrity, validator changes, protocol labeling, and secret/safety scanning rather than exhaustive line-by-line reading of every added test.
Prospective investment performance is pending by design and cannot be assessed; conservative token-rate cost figures are not independently retrieved provider bills, as the evidence itself discloses.

findings.title: record_attempt_event only catches OSError; missing/None results_dir raises uncaught KeyError/TypeError in propagate()

Issuer-specific hard-coded patterns (NVIDIA CIK 0001045810, DOCN headline regexes) embedded in the shared disclosure validator/discovery path; wording drift silently reverts coverage with no structured signal
_validate_price_outcome does not revalidate the nested outcome's entry_policy string (exit policy, dates, prices and returns are checked), slightly weakening endpoint-policy immutability guarantees

Acceptance receipts (pytest logs, live-run artifact hashes) referenced by committed evidence JSONs reside in untracked results/docn-abc/ paths, so key acceptance claims are attested rather than independently verifiable from the frozen manifest
